name: TravelTokyo - AI Expense Tracking via Telegram (Google Gemini)

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "contents": [
    {
      "parts": [
        {
          "text": "You are the TravelTokyo AI Expense Parser for a Tokyo trip.
Analyze this text message: '" + $json.message.text + "'.

TASK 1: Determine if this is a real paid expense transaction (e.g. 'Ramen 1500 jpy cash', 'suica reload 2000 bdo') OR a non-expense message (e.g. 'Good morning', 'We arrived in Asakusa', 'Where is the station?').
TASK 2: If it is an expense, extract all details.

Output strictly valid JSON:
{
  "is_expense": boolean,
  "non_expense_reason": string (if not an expense),
  "title": string (Merchant name / item description),
  "amount": number (Total in JPY integer),
  "currency": "JPY",
  "category": string (Must be ONE of: 'food', 'transport', 'shopping', 'tickets', 'hotel', 'flights', 'documents', 'other'),
  "paymentMethod": string (Must be ONE of: 'Cash', 'BDO JCB', 'BDO Mastercard', 'RCBC Visa', 'GCash', 'MariBank', 'UnionBank Visa', 'Other Card / Wallet'),
  "date": string (YYYY-MM-DD format),
  "status": "paid",
  "notes": string,
  "needs_clarification": boolean,
  "clarification_question": string
}

Payment Methods:
- cash -> 'Cash'
- bdo jcb / jcb -> 'BDO JCB'
- bdo / mastercard -> 'BDO Mastercard'
- rcbc / visa -> 'RCBC Visa'
- gcash -> 'GCash'
- maribank -> 'MariBank'
- unionbank -> 'UnionBank Visa'
- default: 'Cash'

If this is a non-expense conversational message, set is_expense=false."
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "generationConfig": {
    "temperature": 0.1,
    "response_mime_type": "application/json"
  }
}

parameters.text:
=⚠️ *Duplicate Expense Detected*

This transaction (*{{ $json.title }}* for *¥{{ $json.amount.toLocaleString() }} JPY* on {{ $json.date }}) was already recorded recently.

_Skipped to prevent double-counting in your budget._

=📸 *Photo / Message Received*

No receipt or monetary expense detected ({{ $json.reason }}).

_Your budget balance remains unchanged._
